title: The Medical Chamber Law of 2023
goal: I can describe the law of 28 February 2023 on the Medical Chamber and the reactions to it, with dates (*kötelező tagság, önkéntes, kivételes eljárás*).
I can report an open question with *hogy … -e* (*vitatott volt, hogy a törvény az orvosokat védte-e*).
I can say what the state secretary, the chamber's president and the European Commission stated.
